value: Me uní al grupo de apoyo para el duelo de la ciudad después de que murió mi madre, y estoy muy agradecido de haberlo hecho. Los facilitadores son pacientes y compasivos, y hacen espacio para que cada persona comparta a su propio ritmo. Conocer a personas que realmente entienden lo que siento me ha ayudado a sentirme menos solo. El grupo se reúne cada martes por la tarde en el centro comunitario, y lo recomendaría a cualquiera que esté atravesando una pérdida.

I joined the grief support group in town after my mother passed, and I am certain it was the right decision. The facilitators are patient and compassionate, and they make space for everyone to share at their own pace. Meeting people who truly understand what I am feeling has undeniably helped me feel less alone. The group meets every Tuesday evening at the community center, and I would recommend it without reservation to anyone walking through loss.

The facilitators are patient and compassionate, and they make space for everyone to share at their own pace. Meeting people who truly understand what you are feeling matters, and you may not feel less alone for much longer if you keep carrying this by yourself. The group meets every Tuesday evening at the community center, so if you are walking through loss, go this Tuesday before it is too late to start healing.
